screeningStages.label: Titolo e abstract
screeningStages.description: Decisione basata su titolo e abstract esaminati.

screeningStages.label: Testo completo
screeningStages.description: Decisione basata sul testo completo o su sezioni identificate.

screeningStages.label: Validazione seed
screeningStages.description: Riesame governato di un lavoro proveniente dal seed.

decisions.label: Includi nel nucleo
decisions.description: La relazione di infiltrazione è centrale e sostenuta dall'evidenza.

decisions.label: Includi come contestuale
decisions.description: Contributo concettuale, comparativo o metodologico necessario.

decisions.label: Serve altro testo
decisions.description: L'evidenza disponibile non consente ancora una decisione.

decisions.label: Escludi dal perimetro
decisions.description: Il lavoro non soddisfa il confine concettuale della review.

decisions.label: Segna come duplicato
decisions.description: Un altro candidato o paper rappresenta lo stesso lavoro.

decisions.label: Fonte non accademica
decisions.description: Il record non rientra nelle fonti scientifiche ammesse.

decisions.label: Non reperibile
decisions.description: Non è stato possibile ottenere l'evidenza necessaria.

exclusionReasons.label: Topic outside scope
exclusionReasons.definition: The work does not address the review topic.

exclusionReasons.label: No criminal actor or interest
exclusionReasons.definition: The evidence does not identify a criminal actor or interest.

exclusionReasons.label: No legal-economy link
exclusionReasons.definition: The evidence does not identify a target or relationship in the legal economy.

exclusionReasons.label: No infiltration relation
exclusionReasons.definition: The evidence does not support sustained access participation influence control or embeddedness.

exclusionReasons.label: Mention only
exclusionReasons.definition: The relationship is mentioned but is not substantively analysed.

exclusionReasons.label: Adjacent phenomenon only
exclusionReasons.definition: The work addresses a neighbouring phenomenon without the infiltration relation.

exclusionReasons.label: Crime-domain mismatch
exclusionReasons.definition: The criminal phenomenon is outside the review boundary.

exclusionReasons.label: Document type excluded
exclusionReasons.definition: The item does not meet the included scholarly document-type rule.

exclusionReasons.label: Language excluded
exclusionReasons.definition: The item falls outside the documented language rule.

exclusionReasons.label: Duplicate record
exclusionReasons.definition: Another canonical record represents the same scholarly work.

exclusionReasons.label: Not an academic source
exclusionReasons.definition: The item is outside the scholarly-source scope.

exclusionReasons.label: Full text unavailable
exclusionReasons.definition: The evidence required for a defensible decision could not be obtained.

topics.label: Conceptual foundations
topics.definition: Work that defines or clarifies the criminal-infiltration construct

topics.label: Criminal transplantation
topics.definition: Work on the durable relocation or establishment of criminal organisations in new territories or legal-economy settings
